protocol.validation: group K-fold by InChIKey, shuffled compound order, round robin
protocol.model: XGBRegressor with the frozen v1.0 hyper-parameters
protocol.physical_block: frozen xTB vector with T_K replaced by the observation's T_K
protocol.paired_rule: folds are dealt over the compounds of the scored mask only, so protocols that score the same rows share one fold assignment even when their training pools differ

band_room_only.description: train and score on room_temperature rows, grouped 10x5 (band-ablation reference)

train_core_test_room.description: train on room+extended rows, score on room rows only; same folds and same scored rows as band_room_only

train_all_test_room.description: train on every band, score on room rows only; same folds and same scored rows as band_room_only

band_all.description: train and score on every band, grouped 10x5 (band-ablation reference)

window_family.shared_fold_basis: the scored room-band rows of every fold, per repeat

cohort_v10_frozen.description: v1.0 cohort, one frozen v1.0 row per compound: v1.0 features and the curated dielectric label
cohort_v10_frozen.train_mask: the single frozen v1.0 cohort rows

cohort_single_row.description: v1.0 cohort, one room row per compound (nearest 298.15 K), v1.1 observation label
cohort_single_row.train_mask: the single room rows of the cohort

cohort_room_train_single_test.description: v1.0 cohort, train on every room row, score the single nearest-298.15 K room row; same scored rows as cohort_single_row
cohort_room_train_single_test.train_mask: every room row of the cohort

cohort_room_rows.description: v1.0 cohort, train and score on every room row, grouped 10x5
cohort_room_rows.train_mask: every room row of the cohort

cohort_family.shared_fold_basis: the cohort compounds, dealt once and reused by all four protocols

frozen_endpoint.protocol: v1.0 RepeatedKFold(5x10, seed=42) over the frozen 236-compound table
v1.0 RepeatedKFold(5x10, seed=42) over the frozen 236-compound table
